blocks.text: How to reason it out

Binary is positional notation: counting from the right, positions 0, 1, 2, ... contribute 2^0, 2^1, 2^2, ... when their bit is one. Therefore position 5 contributes 2^5 = 32. The 8-bit width establishes that position 5 exists; unsigned interpretation means every set position contributes a nonnegative place value.
